title: The Certificate's Share of a Party's Prepaid Cost
content:
A certificate of the Travel Protection Plans may cover fewer travellers than the party that booked the
holiday, and only that certificate's share of the prepaid cost is carried into a corrected declaration. The
party is read from the operator's record for the packaged holiday held under the Vacation Package Products,
which counts the adults and the children in it separately.

## The three readings

| What the two records show | The share of the party the certificate covers |
|---|---|
| The party on the holiday is larger than the travellers named on the certificate, and the party is made up of adults only | The travellers named over the adults in the party |
| The party is larger than the travellers named, and children travel in it | The travellers named over everyone in the party, children counted |
| Neither of those | The whole of that cost |

## Points of judgement

Where a party of four adults booked the holiday and the certificate names two of them, the first reading holds
and half the prepaid cost is carried. Where the party is two adults and two children and the certificate names
the two adults, the second reading holds and the share is two over four, children counted, and again half is
carried. Where the party is two adults and the certificate names both, neither of the first two readings holds
and the whole of the prepaid cost is carried. Where the certificate names more travellers than the party on the
holiday, the third reading holds likewise and the whole is carried.
